mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 2.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS <= 2.0% as a predictor of 20-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals worsening labor market conditions that prompt aggressive Federal Reserve rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1% in the prior month indicate severe demand contraction, triggering Federal Reserve monetary easing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 1% and HOUST decline > 1% in last 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by >1% in prior month, or interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) during a deep recession signals severe supply-side contraction that prompts aggressive Federal Reserve rate cuts, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 as a predictor of 20-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of deep recession instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 2.0% (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals imminent monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 2.0% as a predictor of 5-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand that prompts Federal Reserve rate cuts, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS decline as a predictor of 20-day forward returns is negative or below 0.03, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 500,000 in the prior month signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers Federal Reserve rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines by >500k, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-Lehman collapse regime (after September 15, 2008), industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals ongoing economic contraction that triggers aggressive Federal Reserve monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 55% of instances during the post-Lehman collapse period, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 is negative or below 0.03.
